decision_request.feedback: APPROVE exact 78b805cb976f9aac87f2e8906ef064bc10909a27. Both independently identified launch-mode blockers are resolved. Ordinary continuity ticks remain independent of the one tracked launcher batch. gather(return_exceptions=True) now joins every child before returning observed failures, so a SQLite error cannot orphan sibling mutations or release the shutdown barrier early. My previous SQLite counterexample now passed with four real held worker threads: batch remained pending after the error and after stop request, maximum concurrency stayed four, queued work did not begin, all workers exited before failed_projects=1 returned. Malformed stored ACCEPTED/STOPPED types return OPERATION_CORRUPT 409. Eleven focused independent checks passed (10 reconciliation/lifespan checks plus the independent prior-counterexample probe). Unchanged authorization/receipt/owner/cancellation guards retain the prior reviewed security properties. No native/live Bot/model/production executor validation is claimed.
